lines.zh: 我一摆尾，水就往后炸开。
lines.en: One flick of my tail blasts the water back.
Only water is road; the shore is not.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我一下就过去了。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am already past you.

lines.zh: 箭鱼游起来像脱弦的箭。
lines.en: A rocketfish swims like an arrow off the string.
I hug the riverbed to save my strength.

lines.zh: 银鳞划过水面，留一道线。
lines.en: Silver scales cut the surface, leaving a line.
Swimming upstream, my scales catch the light.
I circle the weeds without touching them.
Two hands long, and that is fast enough.
There is a shadow behind me; I speed up.
Deep water runs colder, and I prefer it.

lines.zh: 拐弯不用减速，我身子软。
lines.en: I corner without slowing; my body bends.

lines.zh: 你看到的那道水痕是我。
lines.en: That ripple you saw is me passing.

lines.zh: 我从石头缝里穿过去了。
lines.en: I slipped straight through the gap in the rocks.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流冲，省一半力。
lines.en: I ride the current and save half my strength.

lines.zh: 一条水草缠住尾巴，我甩开。
lines.en: A strand of weed snags my tail; I shake it off.
I hover by the weeds and think of nothing.
The sand on the riverbed is warm, just right.
A fish keeps circling right beside me.
The bubble hits the surface and bursts.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，晃得我犯困。
lines.en: The light on the surface makes me sleepy.

lines.zh: 我不追东西，等它撞上来。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for things to bump me.
Two hearts of body, and it weighs little.

lines.zh: 我在听远处的水声变了。
lines.en: I listen as the distant water changes sound.

lines.zh: 河湾这里安静，适合休息。
lines.en: This bend of the river is quiet, good for rest.
A scrap of algae keeps me chewing for hours.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏进石头阴影里。
lines.en: I tuck myself into the shadow of a stone.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面走，我不看。
lines.en: Something walks on the surface; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻摆，只为不沉下去。
lines.en: My tail flicks just enough to keep me afloat.

lines.zh: 这块河湾的每道暗流我都知道。
lines.en: I know every undertow in this bend.

lines.zh: 你站在泥岸上，我停在浅水。
lines.en: You stand on the muddy bank; I hover in the shallows.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我的河底。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the bottom where I rest.
Are you coming in, or walking away?

lines.zh: 你的手指在动，我全看见了。
lines.en: Your fingers are moving; I see all of it.

lines.zh: 你的靴子一响，我就转身。
lines.en: One creak from your boot and I turn away.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在水里看不清。
lines.en: Your eyes are unclear through the water.

lines.zh: 这么大的东西，也会饿吗？
lines.en: A thing that size, does it get hungry too?
I see the net; put it away.
You have stood on that bank too long.
I am curious, but I will not come close.
Do not poke me; I am only a small fish.
A scale came off, and it stings.
What did I even do?
That blow makes me want the riverbed.
I circle you because I am afraid.

lines.zh: 我的血把浅水染出一片红。
lines.en: My blood stains the shallows red.

lines.zh: 我拼命摆尾，才没被抓住。
lines.en: I flail my tail just enough to escape.
The pain made me forget which way to flee.

lines.zh: 你还要打一条两心的鱼？
lines.en: Would you keep hitting a two-heart fish?
I cannot swim well now; stay back.
That worm in your hand, I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 钩子藏得再好我也看见。
lines.en: You can hide the hook, I still see it.

lines.zh: 面包屑落在水上，我绕开。
lines.en: Bread crumbs land on the water; I swim around.

lines.zh: 饵太整齐，不像自己掉下来的。
lines.en: That bait is too neat to have fallen by itself.

lines.zh: 你撒一把饵，我就退一丈。
lines.en: You scatter bait, I retreat ten feet.

lines.zh: 那味道太香了，反而可疑。
lines.en: It smells too good, which makes it suspect.

lines.zh: 我吃过一次，尾巴被划破了。
lines.en: I ate once and my tail was cut open.

lines.zh: 你换种吃的，我说不定来。
lines.en: Offer something else and maybe I will come.
There is already food here in the water.

lines.zh: 别摇那根线，晃得我心慌。
lines.en: Stop jiggling that line; it makes me nervous.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你没什么感觉吧。
lines.en: You bumped me; you probably felt nothing.
I am this small; do not hit me with an oar.
You stepped into the water; I darted away.
A boat hull scraped the scales on my back.

lines.zh: 被挤到石头上，鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: Pinned against a stone, I lost a scale.
Do not stir the water with your feet; I get dizzy.

lines.zh: 我躲得开，只是慢了一瞬。
lines.en: I can dodge, just a moment too late.
In this water, anyone can bump into me.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我回河湾的路。
lines.en: You are blocking my way back to the bend.
A bump does not count as an attack, right?
When the spring water warms, I look for a mate.
We swim in pairs, silver scales crossing.
He chased me around the weeds three times.

lines.zh: 产卵的地方要水浅、石多。
lines.en: The spawning bed needs shallow water and stones.
My mate is a little faster than I am.

lines.zh: 成群的箭鱼，河面都亮了。
lines.en: With a school of us, the river surface brightens.
We build no nest; we only find stone cracks.
He guards the eggs; I go find food.
One fish alone can still live a whole life.

lines.zh: 河湾里的鱼都认识彼此。
lines.en: Every fish in this bend knows the others.

lines.zh: 我从水底叼起一块亮石。
lines.en: I picked up a bright stone from the bottom.

lines.zh: 这片水草我拿回去垫窝。
lines.en: I will take this weed back to line my spot.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西，我先看。
lines.en: When something falls in, I look first.
If I can bite it, I carry it off.

lines.zh: 你掉的那颗珠子，沉底了。
lines.en: That bead you dropped sank to the bottom.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞不下这么大的东西。
lines.en: My mouth cannot hold something that big.

lines.zh: 亮片在水里像另一条鱼。
lines.en: The shiny bit looks like another fish.

lines.zh: 我只是路过，顺便叼一口。
lines.en: I was passing by and grabbed a bite.
Do not throw things in; they sink.
I am taking it; do not follow.
That shadow in the water just got bigger.
I watch it, ready to bolt at any moment.
A dark shape slides along the riverbed.
I tense my tail and pick an escape route.
That is not how weeds sway.

lines.zh: 水面暗了一块，是大东西。
lines.en: A dark patch on the surface means something large.

lines.zh: 我认得这种靠近的方式。
lines.en: I know that way of approaching.
It means to catch me; I can tell.
My scales are already standing up.
Not running yet; let me confirm first.
I back behind a stone and only watch.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅滩，我退到深水。
lines.en: You step into the shallows; I retreat to deep water.
Under the surface I hold perfectly still.
I am looking for a gap to dive into.
You cannot catch me unless I tire.
I circle the same stone again and again.
A hand reaches down; I slip into a stone crack.
My breathing is shallow; I save it.
The river bend's exit is narrow; I go first.
Do not block both sides; I only use one.

lines.zh: 我用头撞你脚踝，立刻逃。
lines.en: I headbutt your ankle and immediately flee.

lines.zh: 这一口很小，你不在意吧。
lines.en: This bite is tiny; you will not mind.
All I know is ramming with my head.

lines.zh: 被逼到石头边，我才还手。
lines.en: Only cornered against stone do I strike back.
Bite your ankle, then slip away.
I am weak, but my teeth are sharp.
Do not grab me; I thrash in every direction.
Consider that my resistance.
If I cannot win, I dive into a hole.

lines.zh: 我咬一口水的声响更大。
lines.en: My bite makes more noise than damage.
I hatched from an egg, very small.
My first mouthful of water made me spin.
One more silver shadow in the bend.
All I know is swimming forward.
The surface is high above me.
Every fish around me is bigger.
I hide in the weeds and watch a while.
My tail does not obey me yet.
I have memorized this river.
Barely hatched, I already knew how to flick my tail.
Boiling water scalds my scales; I leap out.
Swept over a waterfall, I landed stunned.
Even I can be smothered without air.
The blast throws the water apart; I flip over.

lines.zh: 有东西从我身边穿过去。
lines.en: Something shot straight past my side.
The water suddenly went blindingly bright.
Hunger has me chewing the roots of weeds.
Current ran through the water and my fins locked.
There is no water here; I am dying.
